request.subject: PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:BATTLESHIP

layers.text: Recolour only the dark maroon red lines and shadows of the log hull: they become dark brown wood, colour #4a2c14, not red and not maroon. Keep the spotted hide sails, the blue plesiosaur head with orange stripes, the feathers, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
